reviews.text: 1st time visiting. Exceptional service today. You took very good care of my little chihuahua when she had her nails cut. Thank you for your care and kindness.
So happy with Poppy’s groom at Plush Puppy! She looks gorgeous, with a beautifully tidy coat and the cutest little face. Thank you for taking such lovely care of her. We’ll definitely be back! 🐶💛

We’ve been using Giedre and her team at Plush Puppy Spa for years and we’ve always had an amazing service from them. Our dogs always come home looking and smelling fantastic. We will always use them and can highly recommend them.
Very efficient and calming with my excitable sausage

Took my 2 fur babies yesterday  they were a balls of fluff when I left them, now they look beautiful and groomed to perfection . First time visit for them really happy with all aspects of service provided . Would recommend Plush Puppy Spa *****
Lovely caring team , do a great job
My dog is quite a nervous girlie and the staff at this groomers are very kind and patient with her. They do a lovely job when she goes for a groom and she always looks lovely when they gave finished.
I’ve had my Pomeranian groomed here several times & I give them a 5 star review for the best hair cut he’s ever had! I I would never go anywhere else 🐾 …
Love taking Bruce , my dog, to groomers, plush puppy always does a lovely job and the lady there is so friendly. Bruce always comes out looking fresh and smelling great. Would highly recommend 👍🏻 …
My Guide Dog was treated like the super star he is  and the staff were so friendly and welcoming. Would definitely recommend 💕🦮🦮💕 …
Milo customer for the last 9 years, always looks great after his visits.
Cant rate them highly enough. Professional, approachable & caring. My 2 pooches always look better following a visit to groomers🫶🏾🐶🫶🏾 …

Milo has been going to
Plush Puppy Spa since he was 4 months old. I’ve tried other groomers when Plush Puppy Spa has been fully booked but they don’t compare. They are so patient with Milo and he always looks great. If you’re looking for a reliable dog groomer with attention to detail for your pooch, it’s got to be Plush Puppy Spa x
We have been using Plush Puppy Spa for years really pleased with the service how our dog is transformed
Our King Charles cavalier bud gets excited every time we take him to plush puppy - they look after him and he comes back looking adorable - fully clean and fresh - thank you for the best service
My puppy loves coming to those spa. He always leaves looking a dapper boy. Cannot rate this place enough

I have been to 3 different groomers in Sutton Coldfield and this groomers is by far the best my dog looks beautiful. Been there 3 times now ,  the staff are really welcoming and are really good with my Teddy
I took my cocker spaniel for the first time a few months back and I wasn’t sure what to request however I left this in their hands and they did a fantastic job I will certainly will be back !

I brought my cockapoo Teddy to be groomed at plush puppy spa for the first time this weekend after not being happy with his previous groomers. i was a little nervous taking him as he can be very anxious when left somewhere new and with people he doesn't know. However Giedre was so welcoming and kind she made both me and teddy feel relaxed and reasured. I couldn't be happier with the way he looks she's done an amazing job with his groom. He looks even better than i imagined! he came home so soft and fluffy and he smells beautiful too! I love the extra effort put in by putting a cute bow on his collar! I'll definitely be coming back to this groomers now i wish i brought him sooner! it'll be teddys new spa! We both can't wait for his next visit. Thank you so much!. Jemma ❤️ 🐾

I took Ben to plush puppy spa for ten times and there done a amazing a job and gave me a great experience and there followed instructions there cut him and there done nails and smells like a new dog and l like to thank the members of staff for looking after Ben. I would recommend to friends and family and using plush puppy in the near future.

Had a wonderful experience with Giedre, she did an excellent job on my Shih tzu Angel, a beautiful cut at a reasonable price. My Angel was so calm and relaxed when I arrived to pick her up. Totally different to the past groomers I took her to..
I highly recommend this lovely place.

Giedre is the best dog groomer in and around the Sutton Coldfield area!! FACT. She is absolutely brilliant, always does the most amazing job with my pooch and she's clearly very, very caring and passionate about what she does! I have tried other places and no-one comes close.

I recently took my Maltipoo, Ada to Plush Puppy Spa for her first grooming appointment, and I couldn't be happier with the experience! From the moment I reached out to them, the communication was great.

When we arrived at the spa, I was greeted by the owner, who welcomed Ada with such warmth and kindness.

When i picked Ada up, she looked absolutely fantastic! The attention to detail in her grooming was remarkable. She came out looking so fresh and happy, which is all I could ask for.

Thank you, Plush Puppy Spa, for making this experience so wonderful for both Ada and me. We will definitely be back! 🐾❤️

We took Fidget to Plush Puppy Spa for his first puppy groom when he was around 5 months old. They did a beautiful groom, really pleased, he looked beautiful!  They bathed him and did a light trim, particularly focusing on his legs as they were very furry. We then took him for a full groom when he was 7 months old.  Really pleased with what the ladies did, he looked amazing! Superb groomers, they ask you how you would like your dog cut, and then work within this, cannot fault, Fidget looked, and smelled wonderful. We will be booking him in for his next groom in a few weeks. Thank you so much.
We have brought Miso here twice now and he has had the handsomest cut both times! Will defo be returning!

Previously would go to plush puppy but since moving away been finding it difficult to find a good groomer who takes her time and FULLY grooms our dog without us asking or specifying. Guess we will just have to travel and come back 🤷‍♀️ would 100% recommend …

Sent my gorgeous 4 month old puppy here for his first grooming. He was treated like a prince, was well looked after, and looked so beautiful after! They answered any questions I had and put my mind at ease, will be going back monthly for my boy to have his grooms highly recommend!
Did a brilliant groom on our Cavapoo Ted, made him feel calm & was very helpful, will be using Plush puppy from now on ! Thankyou.
Excellent service! Really happy puppy & customer 🐶 …
Thank you! 🙏  …

Five stars!
Plush Puppy Spa is absolutely fantastic, top-notch grooming experience for furry friend. We'll definitely be back!

Amazing Groomers! They Take Real Care And Attention On Your Dog And Your Furry Friend Looks Absolutely Gorgeous After They Are Done. Better Than Pets At Home Any Day. Ruined our Dogs Cut But Plush Puppy Has Made Him Look Like The Little Cutey He is! Thank You 😁🥰 …
From the moment we started coming, we have had great experiences. Leo is groomed to exactly how we had asked and  the team do such an amazing job at it. We can’t recommend enough!

Giedre and the team always do a great job when I bring my dog (Harry) for a full groom and always accommodate us even if it’s just for a nail clipping. Recently moved back to the area and we’ll definitely be bringing him back.
My little Roo always comes back from Plush Puppy Spa looking absolutely beautiful, smelling great and bouncing around with joy. Giedre always looks after Roo so well, we are so glad we found her!

I have been bringing both my dogs to this Groomers for a number of years from puppies. Geidre is very welcoming and you can see how much she cares for the dogs, always try’s to give the earliest appointment available even when fully booked! I wouldn’t take my dogs anywhere else! Monty and Poppy are calm and relaxed going in and returning every time! 100% recommend 🐶❤️

Excellent place, staff are always so friendly and helpful. When we had issues with captain not liking the crate they adapted how they dealt with him and since then he has been fine. Captain always looks beautiful when he comes home. Would 100% recommend.
Very good place, I would recommend to any one who wants to groom their dog. Best place I’ve been to!!

Excellent service from booking Bella in for her groom to picking her up afterwards. Bella always looks amazing when we pick her up & the lovely staff put a gorgeous bandana on her. Bella always smells amazing & we will never take her anywhere else.
My dogs are well looked after and we are always happy with there cuts
The Plush Puppy Spa team are kind, accommodating and professional. Our boys always come out looking and smelling amazing and we wouldn’t take them anywhere else. Thank you for all you do!
Does a great job at cutting my dogs Bruno hair

This was our first visit to this groomers and a poor one it was. When I came to collect my dog, 3 members of staff gathered round whilst I paid for the service. As soon as my card hit the reader, the owner immediately told me “we will not be able to groom your dog again”. She then launched into the fact that my dog was nervous around having his legs trimmed and tried to unaggressively nip at the scissors. Prior to this booking, I had let them know my dog is nervous and would this be ok and reminded them again on my arrive to the salon. There was absolutely no trying to understand whether anything could be done to accommodate my nervous dog or try to think of ways we can work together to help the situation (he is not aggressive in any way and this was also confirmed by said groomer herself). So I fail to see why her approach was that they can never groom my dog again. The way in which this was delivered was the most awful part of the service! Zero compassion, no consideration and a lack in professionalism. This groomer seems to want to make a quick buck and isn’t bothered too much about the service given. If I had the choice to return, I would steer clear. I left feeling deflated and hurt.

Excellent service my dog looks adorable, I will definitely take Shirley there again.
She’s fluffy and smells so lovely,
Thank you so much I’m really happy.
Michele.
Great local puppy salon.

Great service went to get Molly's nails clipped didn't have to book just turned up did phone n check in advance though. nice n quick n she is loving them so much easier for her to walk on the pavement
